content.comment_body: I'm developing a web application for my [product_name] controller. I can access the web server and it's working fine, but I want to view it on my phone using an app. I can't find an app for iOS or Android—has it been removed?
As far as I know, such an app is no longer available. If you want a direct answer from [company_name], you should submit a support request.

Hi [user_name], Since [product_name] controllers now have their own web server and previously you had to pay extra for the app, interest has probably declined. I think the app is discontinued. Regards, [user_name] (translated with Google)

A web server has been available since the first [product_name] with Ethernet ([article_no]) around 2014. The Android app from [company_name] was released after this. The app was free, but for more advanced HMI features you had to purchase extra elements—one of each was included for free. The Android app didn’t seem fully developed, and its last update was in 2018, if I remember correctly.

The [product_name] app has been discontinued and is no longer available in app stores. While the app itself was free, graphic elements required a purchase. I suggest you use the built-in [product_name] web server instead. For graphics, you can use the [product_name] web editor, which is also free.
You may not have seen that in the current [product_name] [version_no], several users have complained that the custom web option is so slow that it’s nearly unusable.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the mobile app for [product_name] controllers are no longer available for iOS or Android, indicating [company_name] has discontinued it. Some users are disappointed by this change and highlight that the integrated web server is now the recommended replacement, though it suffers from slow performance and is less practical for mobile devices. The [product_name] web editor is mentioned as a free solution for creating web graphics, but concerns about mobile usability and speed remain.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to find a dedicated mobile app that allows easy and direct control of the [product_name] controller from their smartphones. They are looking for a modern and convenient mobile management option similar to what was previously offered.
